asc_inceleme_notu_en:
Move Log turns recorded GPS rides (motorcycle, bicycle, walking, running) into cinematic satellite route videos.

WHAT CHANGED IN 1.66
This release REMOVES functionality; it does not add any. No new permissions, no new account types, no new purchases, no new data collection.
- The live-location map tab (which showed friends' live positions and let a user follow a friend in real time) has been REMOVED. iOS already provides location sharing at the system level, so the in-app duplicate was unnecessary.
- That tab is now "Radio": the friend list with push-to-talk voice messages and 2-person live radio, plus the existing Chat list. This functionality was moved here from the Profile/Settings tab; it is not new.
- "Start recording" (manual ride recording) moved to the "Routes" tab. Behaviour is unchanged.
- Two items were removed from the subscription paywall because the underlying features no longer exist in the app: "Live tracking & convoy map" and "Satellite map". We did not want the paywall to advertise anything the app cannot do.

SIGN IN
Sign in with Apple or Google. No demo account is needed: an account with no rides of its own opens PRE-FILLED with sample rides, so every screen can be reviewed immediately without recording a ride first.

TO REVIEW
1) Sign in with Apple (or Google).
2) Open the "Routes" tab. It already contains 5 sample rides (3 motorcycle, 1 bicycle, 1 walking). The "Start recording" bar sits at the bottom of this tab.
3) Rides that already have a finished video show a play button - tap it and the video streams inside the app and can be saved to Photos.
4) To create a NEW video, a Premium subscription or a video pack (consumable) is required. Both are free to purchase in the sandbox environment: tap "Create video", the purchase panel appears, then choose "3 videos", "5 videos", or subscribe to Premium.
5) Cloud rendering takes about 1-3 minutes. A push notification arrives when the video is ready and it appears in the "Videos" tab.
6) Optional: "Render on this phone" produces the same video on-device without cloud rendering. The screen must stay on while it runs; leaving the app cancels it by design.
7) The "Radio" tab needs a friend to talk to, so it is empty on a brand-new account. This is expected and is not a defect; the Chat segment of the same tab works the same way.

NOTES
- Microphone access is used only for the walkie-talkie: press and hold the microphone button to record a short voice clip for a friend, or join a 2-person live radio session. Nothing is recorded unless the user presses and holds.
- Street View videos are a separate one-time purchase, independent of any subscription.
- Heart-rate overlay is optional and requires a paired Apple Watch.
- Location is used only to record the user's own route. Routes are private to the account and are never shared with other users.
